The page shows ships November 14, 2026 — it's a coming-soon drop, so it isn't buyable yet until the drop opens.

Are you after the dual-coin setup specifically, or would a Bitcoin-only unit you can order today work better?
what voltage is required to run
Read the bsb b30 dual page

It ships with the plug and voltage matched to your shipping address, so standard household power — US units on 110–120 V, EU/UK on 230 V.

The exact draw and whether it wants a dedicated circuit I don't want to guess at, so I've passed that to our hardware guy.
Handed to the team · No confirmed voltage/power spec available for the H15 Dual; would not guess.

The team picks that up Monday at 10am ET and the answer comes to your email.

Meanwhile — where would this run, a garage or a living space?

For a living space the Harlo B30 is the one I'd point you at: ~30 TH/s on 360–450 W, around 50 dB, so fridge-level hum rather than a jet. $899, ships November 30, 2026.

The Magic Miner 40T is more hashrate for $799 but pulls 650 W and more fan noise.

What do you pay per kWh?

At 11.3¢, the B30 runs about $33–37 a month in power; the Magic Miner 40T about $53.

What you're buying is a real shot at a full block — 3.125 BTC — drawn every ten minutes, year after year, plus steady sats to your own wallet in between, and a machine you'll actually learn Bitcoin on.

Want me to set up the B30?
